_readme: 史論 layer, kept apart from the record. Keys are post slugs; each entry pins a dated reading to a commit of posts/<slug>.md, as { "sha": "<prefix>", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": "inline markdown" }. A commit may carry any number of notes — that is the point: the same change reread at ten years' distance is a second document, not a correction of the first. Never edit an old note; add a new one.

great-works-that-read-me.note: 要理解大革命的功绩我们需要回到旧制度，看一看其是如何孕生的，而不是略过那个旧时代
